what: NDT-PREPACK (2026-10-16), measured and not kept: the pooled blocked GEMM packs each 48-wide column block's tiles once, in a pack phase (one task per call and column block, every K block with the variant's own pack) into a workspace attached to the pool, the calls of one job that read one B sharing one copy, and the compute phase's 128-row tasks read them there -- in place of every task packing its own (5.6-12.6% of a one-thread task's cycles, ../beta/). The tiles are the same floats either way, so every product is too.
host: 4-vCPU Intel Xeon @ 2.80GHz container (AVX-512; 32 KB L1d and 1 MB L2 a core, 33 MB L3; the instance of ../fuse/'s session), GCC 13.3 (the trainer builds), Clang 18.1 and 23.1 (the code inspection), Python 3.11.15 (the declared floor); indicative wall times, no PMU

files.prototype.py: the prototype as exact-match edits to a copy of runtime/c at 64bfd62 (bcir_tensor.c, bcir_tensor.h); with PREPACK_STATIC=1 every pool also attaches a static workspace (built with -DBCIR_PREPACK_STATIC=4194304: 16 MB, more than the step's largest job takes, the down projection's pair at 1,486,848 floats) -- the measured tree
files.gemm-entries-t4.jsonl: ../beta/gemm_entries.c built against 64bfd62's runtime/c (arm base) and the prototype's (arm timing), 'gemm_entries 9 4', the two in turn over eight rounds: per line one of the step's twelve GEMM shapes at four threads, its median call, its count a step and C's FNV-1a (the same from both trees on every shape)
files.attribution-t4-{base,prepack}-{1..8}.jso: the step in place at four threads (docs/research/measurements/2026-10-13/scan/attribution.py --src TREE --data DATA --threads 4 --steps 8): base = 64bfd62's runtime/c, prepack = the prototype's; the two in turn, their order rotated, eight rounds

reading: The GEMM shapes alone, weighted by their calls a step: 167.4 -> 184.1 ms (+10.0%), the prototype's median slower on eleven of the twelve shapes (from +1.4% on the forward's 1,024 x 384 x 1,024 to +21.7% on the transposed-A weight gradient 1,024 x 384 x 1,024), faster only on the k and v projections (1,024 x 192 x 384, -9.0%), and ahead in at most four rounds of eight on any shape. In place, medians of eight rounds: the GEMMs 173.0 -> 178.4 ms a step (+3.1%) and the step 235.4 -> 242.0 (+2.8%), the prototype ahead in two rounds. A task's own pack reads B's lines, which every core holds shared, into its own L1 and L2; the pack phase's tiles are lines one core has just written, which the other cores then read from that core's cache, and the phase adds a pool run and its barrier to every call -- sharing the tiles saves only the copy's instructions, the part ../beta/'s probe showed the inner loop does not wait on. A production form (the workspace sized from the decoder's plan and attached by the Python layer, per-call shared and missed counts) was written and witnessed and is not kept with the prototype.
